blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.
blocks.zh: 现代视觉基因模型在符号上运作,它们得到的每一个视觉资产,无论是身份,拼写图,深度图,还是运动视频,都是以符号表示,并附在输入符号序列上. 因此,计算费用很快以调制为主。 然而,大多数这些符号都带有多余的瞬间信息。 我们的关键洞察力是,识别真正新的东西正是古典视频解码器早已解决的问题。 因此,我们首先采用了一种基于解码器的代号调试方法,丢弃冗余代号. 然后,我们提出一个政策上的自我消化(OPSD)策略,来训练一个DiT适配器,能够在不发生质量退化的情况下很好地学习解码器的穿透模式. 它们共同组成了On-Political Codec Distruction(CodecOPSD). 将CodecOPSD 放大到16种条件模式 在我们的视频传播模型上, 它平均在66%的 条件符号上 平均没有质量下降。 因此,去诺化成为2x更快,缓存内存在KV缓存模式中缩水高达73%. CodecOPSD还扩展到其他最先进的预先训练的图像和视频基因模型,其好处随着更多的条件,更长的帧,更高的分辨率而进一步增长.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Creativity rarely arrives in text alone.
To turn an afternoon at home into a video, a creator brings a photo of the living room sofa, a sketch of the room around it, the poses of two people, a picture of the family corgi, and its path scribbled across the floor (Fig. 1 left).
State-of-the-art video generative models can receive all these
conditions as input.
However, modern generative models concatenate all condition tokens into one sequence [ 5 , 29 , 30 ] as inputs, so the attention cost grows quadratically with every added condition.
Fine-grained controllability then leads to severe computational cost.
blocks.zh:
创作很少只用文字出现.
为了把一个下午在家里变成视频,一位创作者带来了客厅沙发的照片,周围的房间的草图,两个人的姿势,一家人corgi的照片,以及横跨地板的路条(图1左方).
最新的视频基因模型可以接收所有这些
条件作为输入。
然而,现代的基因模型将所有条件符号组合成一个序列[5,29,30]作为投入,因此关注成本随着每个附加条件的四倍增长.
精细的可控性会导致严重的计算成本.

blocks.en:
Most existing acceleration methods speed up the denoiser through fewer sampling steps [ 76 ] , FlashAttention [ 56 ] , quantization [ 43 ] , feature caching [ 40 ] , or sparse attention [ 73 ] .
We instead reduce the condition tokens at their source, which is orthogonal to and pluggable into these methods.
Condition signals are highly compressible, since a static background repeats in every frame and a motion path covers a few pixels.
In our daily life, every video we watch or store is compressed by a video codec such as H.264 [ 70 ] , which removes exactly this redundancy.
These codecs are the product of decades of traditional video compression research: rule-based systems that run efficiently on nearly every phone, camera, and browser.
For every pixel of every frame, a codec records how it can be predicted from earlier frames, as a motion vector, and what remains new, as a residual.
These signals thus provide a natural rule for selecting condition tokens of every modality, from natural RGB images and videos to sketches, depth, and motion tracks.
They can be computed in real time on a CPU during training and inference.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的加速方法都通过较少的采样步骤[76],闪存[56],量化[43],特征缓存[40],或稀疏注意[73]来加速凹陷.
相反,我们减少其源头的条件符号,这是正统的,可以插入这些方法。
条件信号可高度压缩,因为一个静态背景在每个帧中重复,一个运动路径覆盖几个像素.
在我们的日常生活中,我们观看或储存的每一个视频都由H.264[70]等视频编码器压缩,这完全消除了这种冗余.
这些解码器是几十年传统视频压缩研究的产物:基于规则的系统,几乎每个手机,相机,浏览器都高效运行.
对于每个帧的每个像素,一个解码器记录它如何能从早期的帧中预测,作为一个运动矢量,什么仍然是新的,作为残余.
因此,这些信号为从自然的RGB图像和视频到草图、深度和运动轨迹选择每一种模式的条件符号提供了自然规则。
在培训和推论期间,可以在CPU上实时计算.

blocks.en:
Turning this idea into a working model takes two steps: selecting the right tokens and adapting the model to learn from them.
First, raw codec signals cannot be used directly and need careful engineering.
We resolve these issues, propose an algorithm to map the signals from pixels to VAE tokens, and adapt the selection to each modality.
Second, pruning alone is not enough, as the model must learn the codec pattern for faithful generation.
We observe that supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leaves a clear gap to the dense model on codec-pruned conditions.
We instead propose adapting the model to the pruned conditions through on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) [ 82 ] , which supervises the model on the states of its own rollouts rather than on noised ground truth [ 2 ] .
Teacher and student are the same base model, but the teacher additionally sees the tokens dropped by codec pruning as inferable privileged information.
The teacher turns these tokens into dense guidance at every state of the student’s own rollout.
We name this method On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD).
blocks.zh:
将这个想法变成一个工作模式要分两个步骤:选择正确的符号,并修改模型以学习它们.
首先,原始的编码信号不能直接使用,需要小心的工程设计.
我们解决这些问题,提出一个算法,将信号从像素映射到VAE的符号,并使选择适应每一种模式.
第二,单打独斗是不够的,因为模型必须为忠实一代学习解码图案.
我们观察到,在有监督的微调(SFT)下,对编码普鲁士条件下的密集模型留下了明显的空白.
我们建议通过政策自我消化(OPSD)[82]来调整模式,使之适应被破坏的条件。 后者监督模式在其自身推出的状态,而不是在被点名的实际情况[2]。
老师和学生是同一个基模,但老师还把被代码搜索掉的符号视为可推卸的特权信息.
老师在学生自己推出的每个阶段都会将这些符号变成密集的指引。
我们把这种方法命名为“政策编码消化”。

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the effectiveness of CodecOPSD, we adapt it to 16 condition modalities in our video diffusion model, namely segmentation, bounding box, identity, sketch, edge, depth, surface normal, human pose, sparse and dense tracking, blurring, grayscale, first-last frame interpolation, continuation, inpainting, and outpainting.
With quality close to the dense teacher, it drops 66% of the condition tokens on average, which speeds up denoising by up to 2.30 × \times and shrinks up to 73% of the memory cost in KV cache mode.
We further apply it to three state-of-the-art models, namely MiniMax-H3 Reference-to-Audio-Video (Ref2VA) [ 44 ] for video generation, MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] for image generation, and Cosmos3 [ 1 ] for physical AI tasks.
At similar quality, the denoising speedup keeps growing with the input scale, reaching 3.72 × \times on MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA with more references, 3.06 × \times on MiniMax-H3-Image at 2048 2 2048^{2} , and 2.30 × \times on Cosmos3, with consistent gains across tasks as diverse as control-to-video, video continuation, video-to-audio, and video-to-action generation.
blocks.zh:
为了证明 CodecOPSD 的有效性, 我们把它适应了我们视频传播模型中的16种条件模式, 即分割, 边框, 身份,草图,边缘,深度, 表面正常, 人类姿势, 稀疏和密集的跟踪, 模糊, 灰度, 第一帧插图, 延续, 油漆, 以及外涂。
随着质量接近稠密的老师,平均会降低66%的条件令牌,从而加速了2:30-\\时间的虚报,并收缩了KV缓存模式内存成本的73%.
我们进一步将其应用于三种最先进的模型,即MiniMax-H3 Reference-to-Audio-Video(参考2VA)[44]用于视频生成,MiniMax-H3-Image[45]用于图像生成,宇宙3[1]用于物理AI任务.
在类似质量下,调试速度随输入尺度不断增长,在MiniMax-H3 Ref2上达到3.72×\时 VA的参考文献较多,MiniMax-H3-Imagy上为3.06x\times at 2048 2 2048^{2}Cosmos3上为2.30x\times,在控制到视频,视频续作,视频到音频,视频到行动生成等多种任务之间都取得了一致的收益.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose codec pruning in controllable generation, which maps the motion vectors and residuals of a standard H.264 codec from pixels to VAE token masks. • We introduce CodecOPSD, where the teacher additionally sees the codec-pruned tokens as privileged information, leaving the student an information gap that is inferable and of the right size. • We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our video diffusion model, and further extend it to the state-of-the-art all-in-one models MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, MiniMax-H3-Image, and Cosmos3. • We show that CodecOPSD outperforms other token pruning baselines and has consistent gains in denoising speed with consistent quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early controllable image and video generators add one condition type at a time, such as ControlNet [ 78 ] , SparseCtrl [ 17 ] , and AVControl [ 5 ] .
Later, more works extend them to multiple conditions for richer creative expression [ 3 , 65 , 51 , 85 ] .
On the other hand, all-in-one models train one network on many condition types. VACE [ 27 ] injects a unified condition module through a context adapter, FullDiT [ 29 ] and EditVerse [ 30 ] place all inputs in one token sequence under self-attention, and UniVideo [ 69 ] and OmniWeaving [ 48 ] pair a multimodal language model with the diffusion transformer.
The recent MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] accepts several image and video conditions at the same time.
These models mostly append conditions along the sequence rather than the channel dimension, so as users bring ever more references, quadratic attention dominates the cost.
This is exactly the problem we are addressing in this work.
blocks.zh:
早期可控图像和视频生成器每次添加一个条件类型,如ControlNet [78],SparseCtrl [17],以及AV控制 [5].
后来,更多的作品将它们扩展到多种条件,以便更丰富的创造性表达[3,65,51,85].
另一方面,全一型机车在很多条件类型上训练一个网络. VACE [27]通过上下文适配器注入一个统一的条件模块,FullDIT [29]和EditVerse [30] 将所有输入都置于一个符号序列中进行自我注意,UniVideo [69]和OmniWeaving [48] 将一个多式联运语言模型与扩散变压器对齐.
近期的MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA[44]同时接受多个图像和视频条件.
这些模型大多沿顺序附加条件而不是频道维度,因此随着用户带来越来越多的引用,四重奏的注意力主导成本.
这正是我们在这项工作中处理的问题。

blocks.en:
In diffusion models, ToMe-SD [ 7 ] merges tokens inside the network, and FullDiT2 [ 19 ] keeps the condition tokens ranked highest by a learned scoring network.
Keep The Essentials [ 49 ] instead drops reference tokens before the network, at random or by DeepGaze [ 35 ] saliency.
Another common practice is to downscale the condition, as in OminiControl2 [ 62 ] , EasyControl [ 81 ] , and AVControl [ 5 ] .
In vision-language models, codec-based encoders such as OneVision-Encoder [ 63 ] , Video-LaVIT [ 28 ] , CoPE-VideoLM [ 55 ] , CodecSight [ 52 ] , and AdaCodec [ 22 ] read the motion vectors and residuals of the compressed stream to skip or compactly encode redundant patches.
These VLM works target understanding, where dropping redundant patches rarely changes the answer, so they can prune aggressively.
Controllable generation is inherently different, since the content of a pruned token still appears in the output, which calls for a more conservative selection.
To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to use codec signals for token pruning in diffusion models, where we map them to 3D VAE tokens and adapt the selection to each condition modality.
blocks.zh:
在传播模型中,ToMe-SD [7]在网络内部合并了符号,FullDiT2 [19] 保持了由有学问的评分网络排名最高的条件符号.
Keep the Basics [49] 转而在网络之前,随机或由DeepGaze [35] 显要降下参考符号.
另一种常见做法是降低病情等级,如Omini Control2[62],Easy Control[81]和AV Control[5].
在视觉语言模型中,基于代码的编码器如OneVision-Encoder [63],Video-LaVIT [28],CPE-VideoLM [55],CodecSight [52],以及AdaCodec [22]读取压缩流的运动向量和余量以跳过或压缩编码冗余补丁.
这些 VLM 工作的目标理解, 投放冗余补丁 很少改变答案,
可控生成在本质上是不同的,因为一个被pruned sords的内容仍然出现在输出中,这需要更保守的选择.
就我们所知,我们是第一个使用编码信号在传播模型中进行符号搜索的人,我们在那里将其映射到3D VAE的符号上,并调整选择以适应每个条件模式.

blocks.en:
In large language models, on-policy distillation [ 2 ] trains a student on its self-generated sequences with token-level teacher feedback.
On-policy self-distillation [ 82 ] lets one model act as both teacher and student, where the teacher additionally sees privileged information.
In diffusion models, D-OPSD [ 26 ] fine-tunes a step-distilled image model without losing its few-step ability, where the teacher additionally sees the target image.
OPSD-V [ 41 ] post-trains few-step autoregressive video models on their own rollouts, where the teacher instead sees real-video context.
DanceOPD [ 84 ] distills several teachers into one student, and supervises a single state of each student rollout.
PDM [ 36 ] and LIFT [ 25 ] distill dense per-frame control into sparse control.
In our work, the privileged information is the condition tokens dropped by codec pruning, where the model learns to preserve quality from a fraction of the original condition tokens.
blocks.zh:
在大型语言模型中,政策衍射[2]用符号级教师反馈来训练一个学生学习其自发生成的序列.
政策上的自我消化[82]让一个模式既扮演老师,也扮演学生的角色,在那里,老师还看到了特权信息.
在传播模型中,D-OPSD[26]微调了一步化的图像模型,同时又不失去其几步化的能力,老师在那里额外看到了目标图像.
OPSD-V [41] 后特拉斯数步自动回转的视频模型在自己的推出时,老师却看到真实的视频背景.
DanceOPD [84] 将数名教师蒸馏成一个学生,并监督每个学生推出的单一状态.
PDM[36]和LIFT[25] 蒸馏密集的每帧控制为稀疏控制.
在我们的作品中,特权信息是被代码搜索所掉下的条件符号,其中模型学习从原始条件符号的一小部分中保存质量.

blocks.en: 3.1 Video Codec Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 视频编码序言

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 2 , a video codec such as H.264 [ 70 ] predicts each block of pixels from a reference block in the same frame or in past frames.
While a codec also involves transform, quantization, and entropy coding, these stages are not relevant to our method, and we focus on how the reference and the residual of each block are obtained.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,H.264[70]等视频编码器会预测同一帧或过去帧中参考区块的每个区块的像素.
虽然一个编码器也涉及变换,量化,以及 en编码,但这些阶段与我们的方法无关,我们侧重于每个区块的引用和剩余部分是如何获得的.

blocks.en:
The codec divides the frames of a video into two types: intra-coded frames (I-frames) and predictive frames (P-frames).
An I-frame has no temporal reference and predicts each block from its neighbours within the same frame (Fig. 2 a).
A P-frame predicts each block from previously coded frames, where the compression encoder finds the best match with classical block-matching search algorithms (Fig. 2 b).
This match is rarely exact, so the codec stores the residual, which is the difference between the ground-truth block and its best match (Fig. 2 c).
In summary, a P-frame t t provides a motion vector m t ​ ( p ) m_{t}(p) and a residual r t ​ ( p ) r_{t}(p) for the block of each pixel p p , while an I-frame provides a residual and no motion vector.
blocks.zh:
解码器将一个视频的帧分为两类:内部编码帧(I-frames)和预测帧(P-frames).

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We build our own multi-condition video model as the main testbed of this work.
It is relatively lightweight and not distilled, and its training data comes with ground truth, so it can be directly trained with SFT.
This enables the extensive SFT comparisons in Tab. 1 and shows the versatility of our method across diverse visual controls, each with its own metric.
Our model starts from a pretrained 22B-parameter text-image-to-video DiT, and its condition tokens never attend to the noise tokens, so it supports KV cache [ 62 ] .
For the first stage, it is initially trained with text and a mix of 16 condition modalities, namely segmentation, bounding box, identity, sketch, edge, depth, surface normal, human pose, sparse and dense tracking, blurring, grayscale, frame interpolation, continuation, inpainting, and outpainting.
Each training sample uses 1 to 5 of them.
All token pruning methods in Tab. 1 are also based on these weights.
In the second stage, it is trained with CodecOPSD for 2K steps on 16 H200 GPUs.
Inference sampling uses 30 denoising steps, and CodecOPSD rolls out the first 8 of these 30 steps in training.
Further implementation details are in the supplementary material.

We compare popular token pruning-based methods.
The Random baseline drops tokens uniformly at random, the same share in every condition.
The Reduced Resolution baseline is the common way to reduce condition tokens widely used in controllable image and video generation [ 5 , 62 , 81 ] , where every condition is encoded at one lower resolution.
The DINO attention baseline keeps the tokens that the CLS token of DINOv3 [ 57 ] attends to most, which chooses the semantically most important tokens.
The Saliency [ 49 ] baseline applies DeepGaze [ 35 ] to keep the tokens with the highest predicted human-fixation density, which represents where a viewer would look.

blocks.en: 4.3 Token dropping and inference

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 compares the token pruning methods at the same overall budget, which drops 66% of the condition tokens on average over all conditions.
Without training, codec pruning is the best training-free method in 8 of the 12 metrics, including FID , FVD , and LPIPS .
After the same number of training steps, CodecOPSD is the best fine-tuned model in 10 of the 12 metrics and stays close to the teacher.
Codec pruning selects the tokens in 1.13 s per case on average on the CPU, in parallel with the VAE and text encoders, while DINO attention and saliency take 23.8 s and 75.0 s on the GPU.
The supplementary material provides a longer SFT training comparison, parallelism of modules, and per-condition token statistics of codec pruning.

This gain is smaller than with full bidirectional attention, since our condition tokens never attend to the noise tokens, which also lets our base model support the KV cache setting, where their keys and values are computed once at the first denoising step and reused by every later step.
Ours is still 1.15 × \times to 1.37 × \times faster, and its KV cache is 62% to 73% smaller.

blocks.en: 4.4 Teacher-student gap ablation
blocks.zh: 4.4 师生差距缩小

blocks.en:
In CodecOPSD, the teacher sees all condition tokens, while the student sees the tokens kept by codec pruning.
The dropped tokens form the gap between them.
For a smaller gap, the teacher is also pruned with half of the student’s codec thresholds.
For a larger gap, the student drops 90% of its condition tokens.
As shown in Tab. 3 , both variants are worse than ours on almost every metric, where FID rises from 23.0 to 23.7 and 23.8, and FVD from 113.8 to 123.9 and 124.3.
Therefore, the gap from codec pruning provides the best balance between what the teacher can teach and what the student can infer.

在CodecOPSD中,老师会看到所有条件标志,而学生会看到通过codec pruning保存的标志.
掉落的标志物构成了它们之间的鸿沟.
对于较小的缺口,老师也会用一半的学生密码阈值来填补.
对于较大的差距,学生会降低90%的状况标志.

因此,与编码剪辑的间隔提供了最佳的平衡,在老师可以教什么和学生可以推断什么之间.

blocks.en: We transfer codec pruning and CodecOPSD together to three other models, which are MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] , the image variant MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] , and Cosmos3 [ 1 ] for multi-task generation.

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Reference-to-video with MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 与MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA的视频参考

blocks.en:
MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] is a recent state-of-the-art video diffusion model with reference-to-video capabilities, i.e., the ability to be conditioned by images or videos besides text.
It can take up to 9 images and 3 videos as conditions.
Besides its diffusion transformer (DiT) [ 50 ] , every condition image passes through the vision encoder (ViT) of its vision-language model (VLM) [ 4 ] .
Condition videos are passed to this ViT as images at a 2 FPS rate.
The vision tokens of the VLM can amount to 33% of the condition tokens in the DiT.
Therefore, we prune both kinds of tokens with the same codec signals in a single pass.
blocks.zh:
MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [44] 是最近最先进的视频传播模型,具有参考到视频的能力,即除了文本外,还能够以图像或视频作为条件.
它最多可以取9个图像和3个视频作为条件.
除了它的扩散变压器(DiT)[50],每个条件图像都通过它的视觉语言模型(VLM)的视觉编码器(ViT)[4].
条件视频以2 FPS速率作为图像传递给这个VIT.
VLM的视觉符可以达到DiT中条件符的33%.
因此,我们用同样的密码信号 将两种符号放入一个通道

We evaluate on 237 selected OmniVBench [ 37 ] cases, the reference-richest ones of each task, and present them by task family in Tab. 4 .
Ours drops 71.6% and 36.2% of the DiT and VLM tokens, respectively, while denoising 1.87 × \times faster on average, with no overall score lower by more than 0.6 points.
In Fig. 6 top, we show that our denoising speedup grows with the number of references, frames, and resolution. Adding CodecOPSD can accelerate denoising by up to 3.72 × \times , while quality matches the teacher model and sometimes slightly exceeds it.
The data curation, the training details, and the results of CodecOPSD on top of other acceleration techniques are in the supplementary material.

Since MiniMax-H3-Image requires a short side of at least 1024 pixels, we upscale smaller reference images to this size.

blocks.en:
Cosmos3 [ 1 ] is a Mixture-of-Transformers model for physical AI.
Its diffusion transformer can be conditioned on control videos such as edge, blur, depth, and segmentation, on history frames for video continuation, and on an input video for audio and action generation.
All condition tokens join the generated tokens in one sequence, so codec pruning applies without modification.
We use Cosmos3-Nano, which has 16B parameters.
Tab. 6 tests four of its conditioned tasks.
On control-to-video with 20 selected PAI-Bench-C [ 83 ] cases per control, CodecOPSD stays within the teacher’s ± 2 ​ σ \pm 2\sigma seed noise or better, with 84% of the segmentation and depth tokens dropped for 1.9 × \times faster denoising and lower drops of 45% and 35% for blur and edge.
On continuation of the 66 center-view Physics-IQ videos [ 46 ] , it drops 89% of the given-frame tokens, denoises 1.93 × \times faster, and keeps the dense Physics-IQ score.
On video-to-audio with 50 selected FoleyBench [ 11 ] clips, it drops 70% of the video tokens and denoises 2.30 × \times faster at the same AV match, the probability that a multimodal judge [ 74 ] accepts the soundtrack.
On video-to-action with 50 randomly selected DROID [ 33 ] episodes, the official setting reads only 17 input frames, but CodecOPSD still drops 44% of their tokens, denoises 1.21 × \times faster, and its 3D end-effector position error against the robot log stays close to the teacher’s.
Visualizations and details are in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In CodecOPSD, codec pruning drops redundant condition tokens with a standard video codec, and on-policy self-distillation adapts the model to the kept tokens.
CodecOPSD matches the dense teacher while dropping 66% of the condition tokens on average.
It works across 16 condition types of different modalities and extends to MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, MiniMax-H3-Image, and Cosmos3.
A promising direction for future work is to bring codec pruning to a finer granularity, for example by reducing the channels of each kept token according to its codec residual.
blocks.zh:
在CodecOPSD中,codec pruning将带有标准视频编码器的冗余条件令牌降下,在政策上自行消化使模型适应保存的令牌.
CodecOPSD 匹配稠密的老师,同时平均降下66%的条件令牌.
它的工作跨越16种不同模式的条件类型,并延伸到MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA,MiniMax-H3-Image,和Cosmos3.
未来工作的一个有希望的方向是将编码螺旋纹带给一个更细的颗粒性,例如,根据编码残基减少每个保存符纹的通道。

blocks.en:
Our internal model is a pretrained DiT with 22B parameters (Tab. S1 ), and Fig. S1 shows how our multi-condition model uses it.
Its 6B audio branch is not loaded, which leaves 16B parameters for video-only generation in all of our results.
Each condition token enters the DiT with σ = 0 \sigma=0 and attends to the tokens of its own condition.
Therefore, its keys and values are computed once and cached [ 62 ] .
Our LoRA [ 23 ] is applied to the condition tokens.

Our internal model also has an 8-step distilled version [ 76 ] with the same architecture, which supports the KV cache in the same way.
The dense LoRA trained on our internal model works directly on this distilled version, so we use it as the teacher without further training.
The student starts from the same LoRA and is trained with CodecOPSD for 2K steps, where every denoising step of the distilled version is supervised.
We adopt this setting for the main example in Fig. 1 , the speedup test in Fig. 4 , and the privileged teacher study in Supp. F.1 .

我们内部模型的密集的LORA 直接用这个蒸馏版, 所以我们用它做老师而不经过进一步的培训。

blocks.zh: 表S1:我们的内部模型。 我们列出内部模型的组件,其音频分支没有加载.

blocks.en:
In Stage 1, we train the dense model as a LoRA of rank 320 with about 2B parameters on top of our internal model.
This stage uses all condition tokens and runs for 50,000 steps on 48 GPUs with a global batch size of 48.
In Stage 2, each fine-tuned row of Tab. 1 starts from the dense model and is trained for 2K steps on the same data, with 49 frames at 480 × \times 640 and a global batch size of 16.
The SFT baselines continue to train the dense LoRA with the flow matching loss [ 39 ] on the ground-truth clips, each with its own token selection method.
For CodecOPSD, we copy the dense LoRA into a trainable student and freeze the dense model as the teacher.
Both the student rollout and the teacher target use a single conditional prediction without classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 21 ] , while CFG is applied at inference.
CodecOPSD is optimized with AdamW at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
During training, the student receives the tokens that remain after threshold-based pruning with the fixed thresholds of Tab. S2 .
Across the four base models, our training data is drawn from parts of OpenVid-1M [ 47 ] , VidGen-1M [ 61 ] , SpatialVID [ 66 ] , DL3DV-10K [ 38 ] , and DROID [ 33 ] , together with images and additional clips from our internal data pool.

在第一阶段,我们把密集型号训练为320级的LORA, 上面有我们内部型号的大约2B参数。
这个阶段使用所有条件符,并在48 GPU上运行5万步,全球批量尺寸48.
在第二阶段,Tab. 1的每个微调行都从稠密的模型开始,在相同数据上为2K步训练,49帧为480×\time640,全球批量大小为16.
SFT基线继续用地面真实片段的流量匹配损失[39]来训练密集的LORA,每个片段都有自己的符号选择方法.
对CodecOPSD来说,我们把密集的LORA复制成可训练的学生,并冻结作为老师的密集模型.
学生推出和师资目标均采用单一的有条件预测,不采用无分类指导(CFG)[21],而CFG则在推论中应用.
CodecOPSD与AdamW优化,学习速度为10−4 10−4}.
在训练期间,学生会收到以Tab为固定阈值的阈值修补后留下的符号. S2号.
在整个四个基本模型中,我们的培训数据来自OpenVid-1M [47],VidGen-1M [61],SpaceVID [66],DL3DV-10K [38],DROID [33],以及来自我们内部数据库的图像和额外剪辑.

blocks.en:
Besides the text prompt, each training sample draws 1 to 5 of the 16 condition modalities described in Sec. 4.1 .
Their labels are extracted offline from each clip, except for edge, blurring, and grayscale, which are computed on the fly during data loading.
blocks.zh:
除了文字提示,每个培训样本抽取第4.1节所述16个条件模式中的1至5个。
它们的标签从每个片段中提取,除了边缘,模糊,灰度,数据加载时在苍蝇上计算.

blocks.en:
Object-level conditions include segmentation, bounding boxes, and identity.
For segmentation, Qwen3-VL [ 4 ] locates the objects in the first frame with bounding boxes, from which SAM3 [ 8 ] tracks each object through the clip.
The resulting masks are rendered in one colour per object, either filled or as outlines.
Bounding boxes form a separate modality and are rendered from the same masks.
For identity, we create a reference image of each object from its crop, either as a single-view identity, which shows one view of the object, or as a multi-view identity, which shows several views of the object in one image.
blocks.zh:
对象级条件包括分割,捆绑箱,以及身份.
对于分区,Quen3-VL [4]用边框定位第一个框中的对象,从中SAM3 [8]通过剪辑跟踪每个对象.
由此产生的口罩以每个物体的一种颜色制成,或者填充,或者作为轮廓.
捆绑箱形成一个单独的模式,由相同的口罩制成.
对于身份,我们从它的裁剪中创建每个物体的参考图像,或者作为单视图身份,显示物体的一个视图,或者作为多视图身份,显示物体在一个图像中的多个视角.

blocks.en:
Structural conditions include sketch, edge, depth, surface normals, and human pose.
For sketch, we use either the line drawings of Informative Drawings [ 9 ] in the anime, contour, and open sketch styles, or the straight lines of M-LSD [ 15 ] .
Edge is a separate modality that uses Canny edges with random thresholds.
Depth maps are predicted by the small model of Video Depth Anything [ 10 ] and normalized per clip without further smoothing, while surface normals are predicted by NormalCrafter [ 6 ] .
For human pose, we render the whole-body keypoints of Sapiens-1B [ 34 ] as a skeleton for each person tracked by SAM3.
blocks.zh:
结构条件包括草图,边缘,深度,表面正常,以及人姿势.
对于素描,我们要么在动画,轮廓,和开放式素描风格中使用信息画[9]的线条画,要么使用M-LSD[15]的直线画.
边缘(Edge)是一种单独的模式,使用具有随机阈值的坎尼边缘.
深度地图由视频深度Anything [10] 的小型模型预测,并在没有进一步平滑的情况下使每个片段恢复正常,而表面正常则由 NormalCrafter [6] 预测.
对于人的姿势,我们把萨皮恩斯-1B[34]的全身关键点作为SAM3跟踪的每个人的骨架.

blocks.en:
Motion conditions include sparse and dense tracking.
For tracking, CoTracker3 [ 31 ] tracks a grid of points through each clip.
Sparse tracking, denoted as motion track in Tab. 1 and Fig. 5 , renders 1 to 20 of the fastest points as coloured squares.
Dense tracking instead renders all points, coloured by their first-frame position and depth as in Diffusion as Shader [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
运动条件包括零星和密集的跟踪.
为了跟踪,CoTracker3[31]通过每个片段跟踪一个网点.
Sparse tracking,在Tab. 1和图5中表示为运动轨迹,使1到20个最快的点成为彩色方块.
深色跟踪使所有点都成色,其颜色为第一帧位置和深度,如在扩散中为Shader [16].

blocks.en:
Pixel-level conditions include blurring, grayscale, frame interpolation, continuation, inpainting, and outpainting.
For blurring, 70% of the clips are degraded by a Gaussian blur with the kernel settings of Cosmos-Transfer1 [ 3 ] followed by down-up sampling, and the rest by a disk, Gaussian, or box kernel, from which the model restores the sharp clip.
For grayscale, the condition retains the luma of the clip, which the model then colourizes.
For frame interpolation and continuation, we retain the first frame, the first and last frames, or other frames of the clip and fill the remaining frames with grey.
Inpainting masks follow DeepFillv2 [ 77 ] and LaMa [ 60 ] or are obtained from SAM3, while outpainting masks follow M3DDM [ 13 ] and cover either the whole clip or the first frame alone.
blocks.zh:
像素级的条件包括模糊,灰度,帧插图,续画,印画,外画.
对于模糊,70%的剪辑被一个高斯因内核设置Cosmos-Transfer1 [3] 的模糊而退化,然后是下行采样,其余的则是磁盘,高斯因,或箱内核,模型从中恢复尖锐的剪辑.
对于灰度来说,条件保留了剪辑的润滑剂,模型然后将它染色.
对于帧内插和延续,我们保留了第一帧,第一帧和最后一帧,或者剪辑的其他帧,并用灰色填充剩余的帧.
涂装口罩跟随DeepFillv2[77]和LaMa[60],或者从SAM3获得,而外涂口罩跟随M3DDM[13],或者只覆盖整个片段或者第一个帧.

blocks.en: B.2 Codec reader and fixes
blocks.zh: B.2 编码读取器和修正

blocks.en:
H.264 [ 70 ] partitions each frame into macroblocks of 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixels, so each token covers whole macroblocks, and its scores follow directly from them.
In contrast, H.265 [ 59 ] and AV1 [ 18 ] select blocks of up to 64 × 64 64\times 64 and 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixels, respectively, through rate-distortion optimization.
A single block can thus span several tokens, which makes the token scores depend on the partition decisions of the encoder.
AV1 also predicts with warped and overlapped block motion, so the motion of a block can no longer be described by a single displacement.
H.264 is also the fastest to encode.
At the fastest setting of each encoder, x264 encodes a 49-frame 480 × 640 480\times 640 clip in 0.06 s, while x265 and the libaom AV1 encoder take 0.17 s and 0.65 s, respectively.
blocks.zh:
H.264 [70] 每个框分割成16×16 16\时16像素的宏块,所以每个符符都覆盖整个宏块,它的分数直接从它们中追随.
相比之下,H.265 [59] 和AV1 [18] 分别通过速率扭曲优化选择了最多64×64 64\时的区块64和128×128128\时的128像素.
单个块因此可以跨过几个符号,这使得符号的分数取决于编码器的分区决定.
AV1也以扭曲和重叠的块运动预言,因此块的运动无法再用单移来描述.
H.264也是编码速度最快的.
每个编码器设置最快时,x264编码49帧480×640480\times640剪辑于0.06s,而x265和libaom AV1编码器则分别使用0.17s和0.65s.

blocks.en:
Our codec reader builds upon the H.264 decoder of OneVision-Encoder [ 63 ] , which is patched to output the residual instead of the reconstructed frame.
While its default behaviour is suitable for reconstruction, it mistakes flat backgrounds and the interior of moving shapes for new content, and these false positives lower the drop rate.
As shown in Fig. S2 , we remove these false positives with four fixes that apply to all conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们的解码器基于OneVision-Encoder的H.264解码器[63],该解码器被补丁以输出剩余而非重建的帧.
虽然它的默认行为适合重建,但它将平面背景和移动形状的内部错误用于新内容,这些假阳性降低了下降率.
如图S2所示,我们删除这些假阳性,有四种适用于所有条件的修补方法。

blocks.en:
An intra block without coded coefficients holds its prediction, which extrapolates the residual of neighbouring blocks across flat regions.
We set these blocks to 128 128 , which denotes a zero residual, and this increases the drop rate of identity references from 14.4% to 74.8%.
blocks.zh:
一个没有编码系数的区块内部有它的预测,它推算出邻近区块的剩余部分跨平坦区域.
我们把这些区块设定为128 128,表示零残值,这把身份参考的下降率从14.4%提高到74.8%.

blocks.en:
An inter block without coded coefficients, including a skipped block, holds a motion-compensated prediction that copies the residual of its reference frame, so the residual of earlier frames persists.
We also set these blocks to 128 128 , which increases the drop rate of condition videos from 70.4% to 77.0%.
blocks.zh:
一个没有编码系数的区块间,包括一个跳过区块,有一个运动补偿的预测,即复制其参考框架的剩余部分,因此早期框架的剩余部分继续存在.
我们还将这些区块设定为128 128,这把状况视频的下降率从70.4%提高到77.0%.

blocks.en:
We read the residual directly from the luma plane of the decoder.
Converting the decoded frame to RGB would instead interpret its 4:4:4 chroma as 4:2:0, which shifts the zero level away from 128 128 and introduces false residual.
blocks.zh:
我们直接从解码器的润滑平面读到残骸.
将解码框架转换为RGB则会将其4:4:4的染色体解释为4:2:0,将零水平从128128移开,引入假残留.

blocks.en:
A skipped macroblock carries the motion vector predicted from its neighbours, so the flat interior of a moving mask appears to be moving.
We export a skip flag from the decoder and treat skipped macroblocks as static, which increases the drop rate of condition videos from 74.6% to 77.0%.
blocks.zh:
一个被跳过的大块 携带着从邻居那里预言的运动矢量, 所以一个移动面具的平坦内部似乎在移动。
我们从解码器中导出一个跳过旗,并将跳过的大块作为静态处理,这把状态视频的下降率从74.6%提高到77.0%.

blocks.en: B.3 H.264 encoding settings
blocks.zh: B.3 H.264 编码设置

blocks.en:
In our simplified setting, an H.264 encoder codes the first frame of a condition as an I-frame from its own pixels and each subsequent frame as a P-frame.
Each P-frame is predicted from a reference frame with one motion vector per block, and the remaining prediction error is coded as the residual.
The constant rate factor (CRF) controls how coarsely this residual is quantized, where a higher CRF removes more small residuals.
The preset controls how much effort the encoder spends on its decisions, such as the motion search and the number of reference frames.
blocks.zh:
在我们的简化设置中,一个H.264编码器,一个条件的第一帧作为I-frame从自己的像素,每个后续的帧作为P-frame.
每个P-帧从一个参考框架预测,每个区块有一个运动矢量,剩下的预测错误被编码为剩余.
恒定率因子(CRF)控制着这种残基如何粗略地被量化,其中较高的通用报告格式去除更小的残基.
预设控制编码器在决定上花费了多少精力,如运动搜索和参考框架的数量.

blocks.en:
We adopt the fast presets in Tab. S2 for two reasons.
First, they encode quickly, so codec pruning finishes before the GPU work on average for all four base models, as shown in Tab. S3 .
Second, they search a small motion range over a single reference, which is the previous frame.
In contrast, slower presets search up to 16 earlier frames, so their motion vectors can point many frames back and no longer measure the motion since the previous frame.
On a test set of 27 condition videos, our setting encodes a clip in 0.058 s, while the medium and veryslow presets take 5.24 × \times and 21.5 × \times as long, respectively.
When x264 is allowed to search 16 frames in the history, 34.5% of the coded P-frame blocks refer to a frame that is 2 or more frames back.
blocks.zh:
我们采用Tab的快速预设 S2有两个原因.
首先,它们快速编码,因此在GPU工作前,所有四个基模型的平均编码完成,如Tab所示. 第3条.
第二,他们通过单一的参考物搜索一个小运动范围,这是前一个框架.
相比之下,较慢的预设搜索高达16个更早的帧,因此其运动矢量可以指向许多帧后,不再测量自前一个帧后的运动.
在27个条件视频的测试集上,我们的设定编码了0.058秒的剪辑,而中速预设则分别需要5.24×时速和21.5×时速.
当x264被允许在历史中搜索16帧时,34.5%的编码的P帧区块指的是一个背面为2或更多帧的帧.

blocks.en:
We disable B-frames, which predict blocks from both earlier and later frames.
Since a B-frame block can take its motion from a later frame or average two predictions, its motion vector and residual no longer describe the change since the previous frame.
In contrast, with P-frames alone, every motion vector points to the previous frame.
With the medium preset, 48.3 of the 70.3 frames in a condition video become B-frames on average, and 54.5% of their coded blocks are predicted from a later frame.
blocks.zh:
我们禁用 B 帧,它预测的块 从较早和以后的帧。
由于一个B帧块可以从后帧或平均两个预测中进行运动,因此其运动矢量和残留不再描述自前帧以来的变化.
相比之下,单是P帧,每个运动矢量都指向前一个帧.
随着介质预设,一个条件视频中70.3帧中的48.3帧平均成为B帧,其编码区块的54.5%是从后方帧预测的.

blocks.en:
Each condition is converted from 8-bit RGB to YUV 4:4:4 and encoded once.
We use CRF 33 for videos and CRF 35 for images, such that small prediction errors leave no residual.
A condition of up to 250 frames consists of one I-frame followed by P-frames.
We disable adaptive quantization and the deblocking filter of the decoder, which would otherwise introduce residual in flat regions and spread it across block edges.
Since the decisions of the encoder depend on the number of threads, we fix it to one thread per two macroblock rows.
blocks.zh:
每个条件从8位RGB转换为YUV 4:4:4,并编码一次.
我们使用CRF 33进行录像,CRF 35进行图像,因此小的预测错误不会留下任何剩余。
一个最多250帧的条件包括一个I帧,后面是P帧。
我们无法进行适应性量化和解码器的解码过滤,否则会引入平坦区域的残留物,并将其分散到区块边缘。
由于编码器的决定取决于线程的数量,所以我们把它固定为每两个宏块行一个线程.

blocks.en: C Evaluation setup and metrics

blocks.en: This section provides the test data, metrics, and settings of all experiments, organized by base model.
blocks.zh: 本节提供按基准模型排列的所有实验的测试数据、度量和设置。

blocks.en: C.1 Our multi-condition video model
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 我们的多条件视频模型

blocks.en: C.1.1 Sampling and pruning
blocks.zh: C.1.1 取样和抽查

blocks.en:
We sample our multi-condition model with 30 steps and a CFG scale of 3 in Tabs. 1 to 3 and Fig. 5 , while Fig. 4 uses its distilled version.
We apply threshold-based pruning with the thresholds in Tab. S2 to the Codec (ours) rows of Tab. 1 , as well as in Tabs. 2 and 3 and Figs. 4 and S3 .
In contrast, Fig. 5 drops a fixed share of the tokens of each condition through priority-based sorting over all of its tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们在Tabs. 1至3和Fig. 5中用30个步骤和3的CFG比例来取样我们的多条件模型,而Fig. 4则使用它的蒸馏版本.
我们在Tab.S2和Tabs的Codec(我们)行中应用以阈值为基础的推算。 2和3以及图4和S3
相比之下,图5通过基于优先排序的方式,将每个条件的符的固定份额降低到其所有符的上.

blocks.en: C.1.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: C.1.2 计量

blocks.en:
FID [ 20 ] is computed on up to 10,000 output frames sampled uniformly from each clip, and FVD [ 64 ] on 49 uniformly sampled frames per clip, both against the ground truth.
LPIPS [ 80 ] compares each output frame with the corresponding ground-truth frame.
Before scoring, the frames are resized to 256 × \times 384 for FID and FVD and to 480 × \times 640 for LPIPS.
In Tab. 2 , imaging quality is measured by the MUSIQ [ 32 ] score in VBench [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh:
FID [20]按每个片段统一取样的最多10 000个输出帧和49个统一取样的片段的FVD[64]计算,两者都与地面事实相反。
LPIPS [80] 将每个输出框架与相应的地面真实框架进行比较.
得分前,帧的尺寸调整为FID和FVD的256×\时384,LPIPS的尺寸调整为480×\时640.
在Tab. 2中,成像质量通过V Bench [24]中的MUSIQ[32]分来测量.

blocks.en:
Each condition metric is computed on the clips that carry this condition.
For most conditions, we re-extract the condition from the output with the same extractor that produced the input.
For identity, we compute the cosine similarity between the DINOv3 [ 57 ] ViT-B/16 class tokens of each identity reference and those of sampled output frames.
For segmentation, SAM3 [ 8 ] tracks each condition object in the output from its first-frame box, and mIoU averages the IoU over the condition objects.
For depth, si-RMSE [ 12 ] compares the Video Depth Anything [ 10 ] depth maps of the output and the ground truth, while AbsRel in Fig. 5 is computed after aligning the scale and shift per video.
For surface normals, we measure the mean angle in degrees between the NormalCrafter [ 6 ] normals of the output and those of the ground truth.
For edge, we compute the pixel-wise F1 score between the Canny edges of the output and those of the ground truth.
For sketch, we compute the SSIM between the Informative Drawings [ 9 ] contour drawings of the output and those of the ground truth.
For bounding boxes, we compute the AP50 of class-agnostic YOLOv8m detections on the output, which are compared with the condition boxes frame by frame.
For blurring, denoted as Deblur in Fig. 5 , we compute the PSNR of the output against the ground truth.
For inpainting and outpainting, mPSNR is the PSNR over the generated region, i.e., the pixels that the condition leaves empty, and thus excludes the given pixels.
For human pose, we compute PCK@0.1 [ 75 ] of the Sapiens-1B [ 34 ] body keypoints of the people in the output against those of the ground truth.
For motion tracks, TrajErr is the mean distance in pixels at 480 × \times 640 between the requested point tracks and the same points re-tracked on the output with CoTracker3 [ 31 ] .
For grayscale, Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} is the CIEDE2000 colour difference between the output and the ground truth.
Dense tracking, frame interpolation, continuation, and first-frame outpainting have no dedicated metric and are evaluated through FID, FVD, and LPIPS.
The metrics for sketch, bounding boxes, and blurring are reported in Fig. 5 , and the other condition metrics are reported in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh:
每个条件衡量标准都是在带有这一条件的剪辑上计算的。
在大多数条件下,我们用产生输入的同一提取器从输出中重新提取条件.
对于身份,我们计算每个身份参考文献的DINOv3 [57] VIT-B/16类符号与抽样输出框的同位素相似性.
对于分割,SAM3[8]从它的第一帧框跟踪输出中每个条件对象,mIoU平均IoU比条件对象.
对于深度,si-RMSE [12] 比较输出和地面真相的Video Depth Anything [10] 深度地图,而AbsRel in Fig. 5在调整尺度和每个视频的转换后计算。
对于表层常态,我们测量输出的 [6] 常态和地面真理的正度之间以度数的平均值。
对于边缘,我们计算输出的坎尼边缘和地面真理之间的像素-明智的F1分数.
对于草图,我们计算出 SSIM 介于 信息画 [9] 轮廓画 输出和地面真实。
对于边框,我们计算输出上的类不可知YOLOv8m探测器的AP50,按帧比较条件箱框.
对于模糊,在Fig中表示为Deblur. 5,我们计算PSNR的输出 与地面真相。
对于内绘和外绘,mPSNR是超过生成区域的PSNR,即条件留下的像素,从而排除给定的像素.
对于人的姿势,我们计算出Sapians-1B的PCK@0.1 [75] 人体在输出中的关键点与地面真相的关键点。
对于运动轨迹,TrajErr是所请求的点轨距480×\times 640与用CoTracker3[31]在输出上重新跟踪的相同点之间的平均像素距离.
对于灰度,QQ E 00\Delta E_{00}是CIEDE2000在输出和地面真理之间的颜色差异.
传感器跟踪、帧插图、连续图和第一帧插图没有专用指标,通过FID、FVD和LPIPS进行评估。
图5报告了草图、边框和模糊度的衡量标准,Tab报告了其他条件衡量标准。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: C.1.3 Test cases with more conditions
blocks.zh: 第C.1.3节 条件较好的测试案例

blocks.en:
Each test case in Fig. 4 uses a different test video, and its conditions are drawn at random from the valid combinations of the training pool, without filtering by quality or results.
In these cases, the drop rate depends more on the condition types of a case than on their number, since dense appearance conditions drop 50–63% of their tokens, while sparse conditions such as motion tracks and bounding boxes drop about 96%.
With the KV cache, the keys and values of the condition tokens are reused at every step, so pruning shortens the attention from the noise tokens to these tokens.
Without the cache, every step additionally processes all of these condition tokens.
blocks.zh:
Fig. 4中的每个测试案例都使用不同的测试视频,其条件从训练池的有效组合中随机抽取,而不通过质量或结果进行过滤.
在这些情况下,下降率更多地取决于案件的条件类型而不是数量,因为密集的外观条件下降了50-63%,而运动轨迹和捆绑箱等稀少的条件则下降了约96%。
随着KV缓存,条件令牌的密钥和值在每一步都会被重用,所以普鲁士将注意力从噪声令牌缩短到这些令牌.
没有缓存,每个步骤都会另外处理所有这些条件符号.

blocks.en: C.2 MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA
blocks.zh: C.2 迷你Max-H3 Ref2VA

blocks.en: C.2.1 Evaluation dataset details
blocks.zh: C.2.1 评价数据集细节

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 is evaluated on 237 cases selected from the 813 cases of OmniVBench [ 37 ] , which cover all seven task families of the benchmark.
Since each case requires a 50-step generation by both the dense model and CodecOPSD, we focus on cases with long input sequences, which are the main target of codec pruning.
Specifically, we rank the cases within each task ID of the benchmark by their number of reference tokens in the DiT and the VLM, as estimated from the inputs.
For task families with one, two, and three or more task IDs, we select the top 30, 15, and 10 cases per task ID, respectively, where ties are resolved in favour of less-covered categories.
From this selection, we evaluate the cases that both models complete on a single H200 GPU.
blocks.zh:
从OmniV Bench的813个案例中挑选了237个案例,对表4进行了评估,这些案例涵盖了基准的所有七个任务领域。
由于每个案例都需要经过密集模型和CodecOPSD的50步生成,因此我们专注于具有长输入序列的案例,这是codec pruning的主要目标.
具体地说,我们根据输入量的估计,按基准的参考符号数对每一任务中的案件进行分类。
对于有1个,2个,3个或3个以上任务标识的任务家庭,我们分别选择前30个,15个,每个任务标识的10个案例,解决关系时倾向于覆盖较少的类别.
从这个选择中,我们评价两种模型在单一的H200GPU上完成的案例.

blocks.en:
For prompt preparation, MiniMax recommends converting the instruction and references into a detailed prompt, with either its online service H3-Context-IR, as used by OmniVBench, or a system built on its official prompting guide.
We adopt the latter approach and rewrite the prompts with Qwen3-VL-32B [ 4 ] , whose system prompt is this guide adapted to silent videos.
Both models generate videos with the same rewritten prompts and the same seed, while the judge receives the original instructions of the benchmark.
blocks.zh:
为了迅速准备,MiniMax建议将指令和引用转换成一个详细的提示,要么使用OmniV Bench使用的其在线服务H3-Context-IR,要么使用基于其官方提示指南的系统.
我们采用后一种方法,并用Qune3-VL-32B[4]重写提示,其系统提示是这个适应静音视频的指南.
两个模型生成的视频都有相同的重写提示和相同的种子,而评委则得到基准的原始指示.

blocks.en: C.2.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2.2 计量

blocks.en:
For video quality, we follow the official code of OmniVBench, where technical quality is measured by the DOVER++ [ 72 ] technical score, aesthetic quality by the Aesthetic Predictor V2.5 score, and physical plausibility by the physics score of UnifiedReward 2.0 [ 67 ] .
Reference fidelity and instruction realization follow the official prompts and rubrics and are rescaled to 0–100.
The benchmark judges these two metrics with Gemini 3.1 Pro, to which we have no API access.
Therefore, we adopt the open Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 53 ] as the judge with the same prompts, a large vision-language model with 125B parameters, 6B of which are activated, that natively supports video input.
We observe that it provides a reasonable understanding of the generated videos for these rubrics.
Token drop is defined as one minus the ratio of remaining to dense condition tokens in each case, which is measured before the DiT and, for the reference tokens in the VLM, before its language model.
Speedup is defined as the summed denoising time of the dense model divided by that of CodecOPSD.
Both are computed per task family, and Overall is the mean over the seven families, following the aggregation of OmniVBench.
In Fig. 6 top, quality is the ratio of CodecOPSD to the dense model, averaged over the five metrics.
Each video is scored at a 480-pixel short side, so that all resolutions are evaluated consistently.
blocks.zh:
对于视频质量,我们遵循OmniV Bench的官方代码,其中技术质量由DOER++ [72] 技术分数测量,审美质量由美学先导V2.5分数测定,物理学分数由United Reward 2.0 [67] 物理分数测定.
参考忠诚度和指示实现度遵循官方提示和标语,并调整为0-100。
基准用双子座3.1 Pro来判断这两个度量衡,我们没有API访问权限.
因此,我们采用开放式的Qwen3.8-Flash-Next[53]作为具有同样提示的裁判,一个具有125B参数的大型视觉语言模型,其中6B参数是激活的,在本地支持视频输入.
我们观察到,它为这些主题提供了对生成的视频的合理理解。
Token dropp被定义为每例中剩余与密集条件符的比值的一减,该比值在DiT之前测量,对于VLM中的参考符则在其语言模型之前.
加速被定义为密度模型除以CodecOPSD的集合解析时间.
两者均按任务家庭计算,总体来看,在OmniV Bench汇总后,这7个家庭的平均值。
在图6上,质量是CodecOPSD与稠密模型的比例,平均在5个度量衡上.
每段视频都以480像素的短边评分,从而对所有分辨率进行一致的评价.

blocks.en: C.2.3 Inference settings
blocks.zh: C.2.3 推论设置

blocks.en:
We use the released 50-step sampler for Tab. 4 and the 8-step FastH3-Omni of FastVideo [ 79 ] for both the speed and quality measurements in Fig. 6 top.
In the DiT, we apply threshold-based pruning to the references, and for reference videos, we further drop part of the remaining tokens through priority-based sorting.
In the VLM, we drop the vision tokens with b i = 0 b_{i}=0 for reference videos.
For reference images, we drop the vision tokens that are dropped in the DiT and also fall below a quarter of the thresholds.
We do not use or compare with a KV cache on MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, since its reference tokens attend to the noise tokens, and we observe that caching their keys and values across denoising steps degrades condition following for both reference images and videos.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 4和FastVideo的8步FastH3-Omni[79]都使用已发布的50步采样器来进行Fig.
在DiT中,我们对参考文献应用基于阈值的浏览,对于参考视频,我们通过基于优先排序的方式进一步降低部分剩余符号.
在VLM中,我们用b i = 0 b _{i}=0 的视觉符号放下来作为参考视频.
对于参考图像,我们放下了DiT中投放的视觉符号,同时也跌落到阈值的四分之一以下.
我们不使用或比较MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA上的 KV 缓存,因为它的参考符关注噪声符,我们观察到,在调音步骤上钉住它们的键和值会降低参考像和视频的状态。

blocks.en: C.3 MiniMax-H3-Image
blocks.zh: C.3 小型Max-H3-图像

blocks.en: C.3.1 Evaluation dataset details
blocks.zh: C.3.1 评价数据集细节

blocks.en: Tab. 5 is evaluated on all 606 cases of GEdit-Bench-EN [ 42 ] and all 400 cases of OmniContext [ 71 ] .
blocks.zh: 对Gedit-Bench-EN的所有606个案例和OmniContext的所有400个案例都进行了评估。

blocks.en: C.3.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: C.3.2 计量

blocks.en:
The judges of these benchmarks are accessed through APIs.
For reproducibility, we instead use the open Qwen3.8-27B [ 53 ] with the official prompts to rate Instr., Consist., and Quality from 0 to 10, so our scores are not comparable to those of the original judges.
Instr. measures editing success on GEdit-Bench and prompt following on OmniContext.
Consist. measures the absence of over-editing on GEdit-Bench and the consistency of subjects and scenes with the references on OmniContext.
Quality is the lower of the naturalness and artifact scores, both of which are rated on the output alone.
blocks.zh:
这些基准的法官可通过API获得。
对于可复制性,我们改用开放式的Quen3.8-27B[53],有官方的提示来评分Instr.,Consist.,以及质量从0到10,因此我们的分数与原评委的分数不相上下.
在Gedit-Bench上衡量编辑成功,并在OmniContext上及时跟踪。
一致,衡量Gedit-Bench上没有过度编辑,以及主题和场景与OmniContext上的引用一致.
质量是自然和文物分数中的较低者,两者均单独在产出上评分.

blocks.en: C.3.3 Inference settings
blocks.zh: C.3.3 推论设置

blocks.en:
All cases use the official prompt enhancer and the released 6-step sampler.
In Tab. 5 and Fig. 6 bottom, we apply threshold-based pruning in the DiT and the image pruning rule of MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA in the VLM.
In Figs. S7 and S8 , the VLM instead drops the vision tokens that are dropped in the DiT.
blocks.zh:
所有病例都使用官方的快速增强器和发布的6步采样器.
在 Tab. 5 和 Fig. 6 底部, 我们在 DiT 中应用基于阈值的 prun, 在 VLM 中应用 MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA 的图像 pruning 规则.
在Figs.S7和S8中,VLM代替了DiT中投放的视觉符号.

blocks.en: C.4 Cosmos3-Nano
blocks.zh: C.4 宇宙3-纳诺

blocks.en:

blocks.en: C.4.1 Transfer
blocks.zh: C.4.1 转让

blocks.en:
Control-to-video generates 121 frames from a single control at 720 × \times 1280, or at 832 × \times 1104 for 4:3 clips, and we evaluate 20 selected PAI-Bench-C [ 83 ] cases per control.
We use the official scorer of PAI-Bench-C, which compares the output with the source video through SSIM for blur, Canny F1 for edge, si-RMSE [ 12 ] of estimated depth for depth, and mIoU of SAM 2 [ 54 ] masks for segmentation.
These scores are not comparable to the metrics of our multi-condition model, which re-extract each condition with our own extractors and evaluate blurring with PSNR.
Segmentation and depth use threshold-based pruning.
For blur and edge, threshold-based pruning moves the quality outside the range of the teacher, so we instead adopt priority-based sorting at the highest tested drop rate that remains within this range, which is 45% for blur and 35% for edge.
blocks.zh:
Control-to-video在720 ×\time 1280,或832 ×\time 1104 4:3片段从单控生成121帧,我们评价20个选定的PAI-Bench-C[83]个案例.
我们使用PAI-Bench-C的官方计分器,通过SSIM将输出与源视频比较模糊,Canny F1表示边缘,si-RMSE [12]表示深度的估计深度,mIoU表示SAM 2 [54] 口罩表示分割.
这些分数与我们的多条件模型的度量标准不相上下,它用我们自己的提取器重提每个条件,并用PSNR来评价模糊.
分解和深度使用基于阈值的修剪.
对于模糊和边缘,基于阈值的修剪会将质量移动到老师的范围之外,所以我们采用基于优先排序的方法,其测试的下降率最高,仍然在这个范围内,模糊度为45%,边缘为35%.

blocks.en: C.4.2 Continuation
blocks.zh: C.4.2 继续

blocks.en:
For continuation, the model observes the first 73 frames of each of the 66 center-view Physics-IQ [ 46 ] videos and generates the next 120 frames, with threshold-based pruning on the given frames.
The results are evaluated with the Physics-IQ score.

为了继续,模型观察了66个中视物理-IQ[46]视频中每个视频的前73帧,并生成了接下来的120帧,在给定的帧上进行阈值的冲压.
评估结果为物理-智商分数。

blocks.en: C.4.3 Video-to-audio
blocks.zh: C.4.3 视频对音频

blocks.en:
For video-to-audio, we generate soundtracks for 50 selected FoleyBench [ 11 ] clips.
AV match is the probability that a Qwen3-Omni [ 74 ] judge considers the soundtrack to match the video, which is 0.842 for the ground truth.
Threshold-based pruning drops 50% of the video tokens, while priority-based sorting at a fixed drop rate of 70% drops more and remains within the range of the teacher, as does the tested rate of 95%.
blocks.zh:
对于视频到音频,我们生成50个精选的Foley Bench[11]片段的音轨.
AV匹配是Qwen3-Omni [74] 法官考虑音轨匹配视频的概率,对于地面真实性来说是0.842.
基于阈值的刷卡会降低50%的视频信物,而基于优先级的排序则以70%的固定下降率下降,并保持在教师的范围之内,测试率95%也是如此.

blocks.en: C.4.4 Video-to-action
blocks.zh: C.4.4 视频对行动

blocks.en:
For video-to-action, the model reads 17 frames from three DROID [ 33 ] camera views and predicts the 16 end-effector actions between them, with threshold-based pruning.
We evaluate this task on 50 randomly selected episodes.
EE err. is the distance between the end-effector position after the 16 predicted actions and the position recorded in the robot log.

对于视频到动作,模型读取了来自三个DROID [33] 相机视图的17帧,并预测了它们之间的16个终端效应动作,并带有基于阈值的冲压.
我们根据50个随机选集来评价这项任务。
EE错误(EE wrong.)是16个预言动作后最终效果器位置与机器人日志中记录位置之间的距离.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. S7 , the single-state setting performs close to the dense setting on most metrics of our multi-condition model and is worse on track following, with a TrajErr of 9.15 against 7.80.
Therefore, the single-state setting is a sound choice when training compute is limited.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. S7, 单态设定在我们的多条件模型中大多数度量标准上都接近密集设定,
因此,当训练计算有限时,单状态设置是一种合理的选择.

blocks.en:
The two settings thus differ little in quality, while the single-state setting saves about two thirds of the training time per step.
This saving matters much more on MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] , whose DiT has 33B parameters, about twice the 15B of our internal model, and whose inputs add long reference videos and a 32B VLM.
On 16 H200 GPUs, one of its training steps takes about 39 s with a single supervised state and about 132 s with eight states.
Therefore, the CodecOPSD LoRAs of MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] adopt the single-state setting, which draws the supervised state at random from a 16-step grid and from the released 6-step grid, respectively, so that every noise level is supervised over the course of training.
blocks.zh:
因此,两种设置在质量上差别不大,而单态设置每步节省大约三分之二的培训时间.
这种保存在MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [44] 上更为重要,它的DiT有33B参数,大约是我们内部模型的15B的两倍,其投入增加了长的参考视频和一个32B VLM.
在16个H200GPU上,它的一个训练步骤是大约39s,一个受监督的州,大约132s,八个州。
因此,MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA和MiniMax-H3-Image [45]的CodecOPSD LoRAs采用了单态设置,分别从16步网格和释放的6步网格中随机抽取受监督的状态,从而在训练过程中监督每个噪音级别.

blocks.en: This section extends Sec. 4.5.1 of the main paper with the training details, a comparison with Training-Free Codec, and the use of add-on LoRAs and few-step models.
blocks.zh: 本节将主要论文第4.5.1节扩展为培训细节、与“无培训代码”的比较、以及添加LORAs和几步模型的使用。

blocks.en: G.1 Training details
blocks.zh: G.1 培训细节

blocks.en:
Since the teacher supervises the student on the student’s own rollout, each training sample consists of the inputs and a prompt, and no target output is required.
The CodecOPSD LoRA has rank 128, about 655M parameters, and is applied to the condition tokens.
It is trained on the 41 tasks in Tab. S8 for 3,000 steps with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , where each step supervises one state of a 16-step grid.
Due to GPU memory limits, each node of 8 GPUs dedicates one GPU to Qwen3-VL-32B [ 4 ] , the VLM of MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, and trains on the other seven, resulting in a batch size of 14 on 16 GPUs.
To save compute, 70% of the training steps generate 56 frames, while the others generate 124 frames.
The student receives the reference tokens that remain after threshold-based pruning, and its Qwen3-VL drops reference vision tokens with the rule of Supp. C.2 .
To make the student more robust, part of the training steps further drop some of the remaining reference video tokens through priority-based sorting.
An earlier LoRA, which is used in Supp. G.3 , is trained on the 24 tasks marked †.
blocks.zh:
由于老师监督学生自己推出课程,因此每个培训样本包括投入和即时,不需要目标产出。
密码 LoRA拥有128级,约655M参数,适用于条件符.
培训内容为Tab的41项任务。 S8为3000步,学习速度为5×10−5 5\时10×5},其中每步监督一个16步格的状态.
由于GPU内存限制,8个GPU的每个节点将1个GPU专门用于Quen3-VL-32B[4],MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA的VLM,另外7个列车,导致16个GPU的批量尺寸达到14个.
为了保存计算,70%的训练步骤产生56帧,其他则产生124帧.
学生收到基于阈值的浏览后留下的参考符号,其Quen3-VL以Supp. C.2 的规则降下参考视觉符号.
为使学生更加稳健,部分培训步骤通过优先排序,进一步减少部分剩余参考视频标志.
较早的LORA在补充部分G.3中使用,培训内容为标为 的24项任务。

blocks.en: G.2 Training-Free Codec versus CodecOPSD
blocks.zh: G.2 培训-免费编码与编码OPSD

blocks.en:
Figure S5 : Training-Free Codec and CodecOPSD on MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA. We show (a) a rough-storyboard video, (b) a video continuation, and (c) a human-pose control video, with condition overlay in (a) and (c).
Both models receive the same remaining reference tokens, inputs, and seed.
blocks.zh:
图S5:MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA上的无培训编码和编码编码OPSD。 我们展示(a) 粗糙的板块视频,(b) 视频续作,(c) 人机控制视频,条件为(a) 和(c) 。
两个模型都收到同样的剩余参考符,投入和种子.

blocks.en:
Codec pruning can be applied to a released model without training, which we refer to as Training-Free Codec.
In this setting, the released weights receive the remaining condition tokens alone.
Since the released model is not trained on references with missing tokens, it cannot tell what the dropped tokens represent.
As shown in Fig. S5 , with 82–92% of the reference tokens dropped on MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] , Training-Free Codec turns a character toward the camera against the storyboard in (a), restarts a motion that has already begun in the given clip in (b), and moves the face away from the human pose condition in (c).
In contrast, CodecOPSD stays close to the teacher with the same remaining tokens.
Reduced resolution drops fewer reference tokens, 79% compared with 92%, but still shifts the whole shot in (a).
These failures motivate the need for training.
blocks.zh:
编解码器普鲁宁可以应用到一个不经过训练就释放出来的模型上,我们称之为"训练-无编解码器".
在此设定中,释放的重量仅获得剩余条件令牌.
由于所发行的型号没有在缺少符号的参考文献上经过训练,因此无法分辨掉落的符号代表什么.
如图S5所示,在MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [44] 上投下82-92%的参考符,“培训自由”编码器在(a)中将一个人物转向镜头对准故事板,在(b)中重新启动一个已经在给定的片段中开始的动作,并在(c)中将脸部移离人体姿势。
相比之下,CodecOPSD则与教师保持近距离,留下相同的符号.
分辨率下降的参考指数下降较少,为79%,而92%,但仍将整个目标移到(a).
这些失败促使人们需要培训。

blocks.zh: G.3 添加到LORAs和几步模型上

Each panel shows the input, where the darkened regions mark the condition tokens dropped by codec pruning, followed by the results of the add-on LoRA or the few-step model with all condition tokens and with CodecOPSD, generated from the same input and seed.
Panels (a), (c), and (e) apply the Real-to-Anime, Muscle, and 360° Orbit LoRAs, and panels (b), (d), and (f) use FastH3-Omni, Pika H3 Flex, and SolarRenderer.

在每一个面板中,CodecOPSD都保留了添加在LORA或几步模型中大多数条件令牌降下的效果.

blocks.en:
More visualizations are available on our project page.
Released models are often used with third-party add-on LoRAs or as faster few-step versions.
We apply codec pruning and our CodecOPSD LoRA to both settings without further training, with add-on LoRAs in Fig. S6 a, c, and e and few-step models in Fig. S6 b, d, and f.
The add-on LoRA acts on all tokens as it was trained to, while our LoRA and threshold-based pruning act on the condition tokens.

发行的模型常与第三方添加的Loras一起使用,或者作为更快的几步版本.
我们在两处设置中都应用了编码普鲁恩和我们的编码OPSD LORA,没有经过进一步培训,在Fig中添加了LORAs. S6 a, c, 和e 以及 Fig. S6 b, d 和 f 中的几步模型.
附加的LORA在训练时在所有的标志上都行动,而我们的LORA和基于阈值的刷新则在条件标志上行动.

blocks.en:
Add-on LoRAs. On MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA [ 44 ] , the community Real-to-Anime 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/akhaliq/Minimax-H3-ref2v_Real_2_Anime , Muscle 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/ostris/minimax_h3_ref2va_jacked_lora , and 360° Orbit 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/MATLOWAI/MiniMax-H3-ORB360-CardSpin LoRAs retain their effects with 54–57% of the condition tokens dropped, as seen in the anime look, the muscles, and the full orbit back to the starting view.
Compared with the add-on results with all condition tokens and the same input and seed, the median PSNR is 20.3, 25.9, and 18.3 dB over 9, 5, and 4 clips, respectively, while MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA without the add-on achieves 15.7, 9.1, and 9.7 dB.
blocks.zh:
添加到LORAs上。在MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA上[44],社区 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/akhaliq/Minimax-H3-ref2v_Real_2_Anime,肌肉 2 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/ostris/minimax_h3_ref2va_jacked_lora, 360°轨道 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/MATLOWA/MiniMax-H3-ORB360-CardSpin LoRAs保留了它们的效果,54%-57%的条件令牌掉落,从动画外观,肌肉,以及返回起始视线的完整轨道中可以看到.
与所有条件符和相同输入和种子的加成结果相比,PSNR中位数分别为20.3,25.9和18.3 dB分别超过9,5和4片段,而没有加成的MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA则达到15.7,9.1和9.7 dB.

blocks.en:
Few-step models. Our MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA LoRA also works unchanged on few-step models trained by others, as in Fig. 6 top.
Fig. S6 shows it with the 8-step FastH3-Omni of FastVideo [ 79 ] 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1 , the 6-step Pika H3 Flex 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex , and the 4-step SolarRenderer [ 14 ] with greybox control.
The two speedups multiply, since few-step models reduce the denoising steps, while codec pruning reduces the condition tokens at each step.
On these cases at 768 × \times 1344, codec pruning makes the denoising of FastH3-Omni, Pika H3 Flex, and SolarRenderer another 1.50 × \times , 1.46 × \times , and 1.79 × \times faster, or 9.19 × \times , 11.20 × \times , and about 21.9 × \times faster than the released 50-step model.
blocks.zh:
几步模式. 我们的迷你Max-H3 Ref2VA LORA同样在由他人训练的几步模型上工作不变,如图6上.
Fig. S6以快视8步快视H3-Omni(英语:FastVideo [79] 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1)显示,6步. Pika H3 Flex 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex,以及四步太阳能放送器[14] 具有灰盒控制功能.
两种速率相乘,因为几步模型会减少去诺音步,而编码推算则会减少每步的条件符号.
在768××时1344分的情况下,编码调试使FastH3-Omni,Pika H3 Flex,SolarRenderer的调试速度又达到1.50××时,1.46×时,以及1.79×时,或9.19×时,11.20×时,比发布50步模式快约21.9×时.

blocks.zh: H 迷你max- H3- 图像

blocks.en: This section extends Sec. 4.5.2 of the main paper, with the same structure as the previous section.
blocks.zh: 本节延伸主论文4.5.2节,结构与上节相同.

blocks.en: H.1 Training details
blocks.zh: H.1 培训细节

blocks.en:
Since MiniMax-H3-Image is released as a 6-step distilled model, the student rolls out this 6-step sampler, and each training step supervises one of its 6 states, drawn at random.
The CodecOPSD LoRA has rank 128 on the attention and MLP projections, about 655M parameters, and is applied to the reference tokens.
It is trained from the released model for 3,000 steps on samples with 1 to 16 reference images, using a batch size of 14 and a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} .
Tab. S9 lists these samples, whose number of reference images grows over three training stages.
The student receives the reference tokens that remain after threshold-based pruning in the DiT, while its Qwen3-VL-32B [ 4 ] also drops reference vision tokens.
blocks.zh:
由于MiniMax-H3-Image作为6步蒸馏模型发布,学生推出这个6步的采样器,每个训练步骤监督它的6个州之一,随机抽取.
密码 LoRA在注意力和MLP预测上排名128位,约655M参数,并被应用到参考符上.
它从释放的模型中培训出3 000步的样本,其中1至16个参考图像,使用批量尺寸为14,学习率为5×10−5 5\Times 10×5}。
Tab. S9列出了这些样本,其参考图像数量在三个培训阶段增长。
学生在 DiT 中接收了基于阈值的修剪后留下的参考标志,而它的Qune3-VL-32B [4] 也降低了参考标志.

blocks.en: H.2 Training-Free Codec versus CodecOPSD
blocks.zh: H.2 培训-免费编码与编码OPSD

blocks.en:
Figure S7 : Training-Free Codec and CodecOPSD on MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] . Both models receive the same remaining tokens after codec pruning, as well as the same inputs and seed, and all images show the same crop.
Within the red box, Training-Free Codec redraws the dropped thin lettering and generates garbled print on the blank label, while CodecOPSD matches the teacher.
blocks.zh:
图S7:关于MiniMax-H3-Image的无培训编码和编码编码OPSD [45]. 两种型号在编码剪辑后都收到相同的剩余令牌,以及相同的输入和种子,所有图像都显示相同的作物.
在红框内,Training-Free Codec重新绘制掉落的薄字,并在空白标签上生成粘贴的打印,而CodecOPSD则与老师匹配.

blocks.en:
Figure S8 : Stacked speedups on MiniMax-H3-Image LoRA without further training. Each case shows the reference images at a short side of 2,048 pixels with the tokens dropped by codec pruning darkened, followed by the results of 2-step PDMD [ 68 ] alone and with CodecOPSD, generated from the same inputs and seed.
Times are denoising seconds per image, and each label shows the extra speedup of CodecOPSD over PDMD alone, which is large here because the references are at a high resolution.
blocks.zh:
图S8:在未经过进一步培训的情况下,在MiniMax-H3-Image LoRA上叠加速度. 每个案例都以2,048像素的短边显示参考图像,其符号被代码普鲁因变暗而掉落,之后是2步PDMD[68]单独和与 CodecOPSD的结果,由相同的输入和种子生成.
时代每张图像都会去Noing秒,每个标签都显示CodecOPSD在PDMD之上的加速度,因为参考文献在高分辨率上,这里的加速度很大.

blocks.en:
On MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] , the errors of Training-Free Codec occur either inside the dropped regions or in the framing of the image.
As shown in Fig. S7 (a), codec pruning drops 88.4% of the tokens of the gift box image, including its thin white lettering, and Training-Free Codec renders the lettering larger and outlined.
In (b), codec pruning drops 61.1% of the tokens of the can photo, including a blank part of the label, where Training-Free Codec generates garbled print.
Since the released model has not learned to read images with dropped tokens, it cannot tell that a dropped region of a label is flat and fills it with invented letters.
In contrast, the teacher and CodecOPSD preserve both the lettering and the label as in the given images.
In other cases, Training-Free Codec changes the framing of the edited image by zooming in and cropping part of the scene.
As with MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA, these failures motivate the need for training.
blocks.zh:
在MiniMax-H3-Image [45] 上,无训练代码的错误要么发生在投放区域内部,要么发生在图像的设定中.
如Fig.S7(a)所示,解码器刷新使礼品盒图像的代号下降88.4%,包括它的细白字母,而Training-Free Codec使字母变大并被概括.
在(b)中,解码器普鲁恩将61.1%的符号的罐头照片,包括一个空白部分的标签,其中Training-Free Codec生成了格子打印.
由于发行的模型还没有学会用丢弃的符号读取图像,它无法分辨一个丢弃的标签区域是平的,并用发明的字母填充.
相比之下,老师和CodecOPSD保留了给定图像中的字母和标签.
在其他情况下,Training-Free Codec通过放大和裁剪部分场景来改变编辑图像的设定.
与MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA一样,这些失败促使需要培训。

blocks.en: H.3 Few-step model
blocks.zh: H.3 少步模式

blocks.en:
For MiniMax-H3-Image [ 45 ] , the few-step model we found in the community is the 2-step PDMD LoRA 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/akhaliq/minimax-h3-image-pdmd-2step , a repackaged version of the LoRA that PDMD [ 68 ] distilled from MiniMax-H3. 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/pdmd2026/pdmd_2NFE_lora With our LoRA added without further training, every reference in Fig. S8 is reproduced.
With references at a short side of 2,048 pixels, codec pruning makes the denoising of PDMD another 4.47 × \times and 3.74 × \times faster, or 13.5 × \times and 11.3 × \times faster than the released 6-step model.
End to end, PDMD with CodecOPSD is 1.79 × \times and 1.54 × \times faster than PDMD alone.
The waxy surfaces originate from PDMD and appear the same with and without CodecOPSD.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
CodecOPSD trains one LoRA of rank 128, about 349M parameters, on the condition tokens of the released Cosmos3-Nano for the tasks in Tab. 6 and image-to-video.
It follows the standard OPSD setting of our multi-condition model, where the student rolls out the official sampler of each task, with 50 steps for transfer and 35 or 30 steps for the other tasks, and each training step supervises its first 8 states.
Each training step draws one task, with transfer on 40% of the steps, continuation on 21%, video-to-audio on 19%, video-to-action on 15%, and image-to-video on 5%, and the clips vary in resolution and length.
We train for 3,000 steps with a batch size of 16 on 16 H200 GPUs and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .

blocks.en:
In Figs. S9 and S10 , we visualize the tokens dropped by codec pruning on Cosmos3-Nano.
Fig. S9 combines all four transfer controls on robot clips, an extreme setting outside Tab. 6 .
Unlike the official pipeline of Cosmos-Transfer1 [ 3 ] , which runs one pass per control, we concatenate the tokens of all controls into one sequence.
This keeps one forward pass per step for an arbitrary number of controls, and codec pruning drops 80% of the control tokens while CodecOPSD stays close to the teacher.
In later frames, the static background is dropped, and the remaining tokens follow the moving arms.
For video-to-action, codec pruning drops 45% of the input tokens, mostly from the static exterior views, and the action path of CodecOPSD follows that of the teacher.
For video-to-audio, CodecOPSD preserves the sound of the teacher with 60–79% of the video tokens dropped.
A Qwen3-Omni judge considers the soundtracks of CodecOPSD and the teacher to be the same sound with a probability of 0.79, compared with 0.20 for two runs of the teacher with different seeds.

blocks.en: J Limitations
blocks.zh: J 限制

blocks.en:
Overall, codec pruning works well across conditions and models, while we also observe a few limitations.
For motion tracks, codec pruning drops the tokens of a point that remains static after the frame where it first appears, so the remaining tokens may confuse a static point with an occluded or masked-out one.
In addition, a few detailed modalities, such as bounding boxes, motion tracks, and blurring, benefit from adjusted codec settings, as listed in Tab. S2 .
We believe that a learning-based search over these settings with pre-computation in advance for each modality is a promising direction for future work and may further improve the balance between speed and quality.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,编码剪辑在各种条件和模式之间效果良好,而我们也观察到一些局限性。
对于运动轨迹,解码器普鲁因在刚出现时的帧后仍保持静态的点的标志物,所以剩下的标志物可能会将静态点与一个被遮住或蒙住的出局点混淆.
此外,一些详细的模式,如边框,运动轨迹,以及模糊,都受益于Tab列出的调整编码设置. S2号.
我们认为,对这些环境进行学习式搜索,预先对每种模式进行计算,是今后工作的一个有希望的方向,并可能进一步改善速度和质量之间的平衡。
